name: Performance Spectrum
author: Promenade Team
description: Fine-grained performance analysis after Denisov, Fahland, and van der Aalst: every observed directly-follows segment is plotted over calendar time and colored by its duration class, exposing batching, queuing, slowdowns, and drift hidden by aggregated averages. On OCELs it can consume source-bound Interaction Atlas lasso cohorts.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Empty means all activities. Selected activities restrict the displayed directly-follows segments without changing case/object lifecycles.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT activity AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {event} WHERE activity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, activity

objectTypes.title: Object types
objectTypes.description: Empty means all object types. Choose one or more OCEL lifecycles to include.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT object_type AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {object} WHERE object_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, object_type

timeStart.title: Time range
timeStart.description: Limit the spectrum to event flows within a calendar-time window. The selected window is applied before segment sampling.

maxSegments.title: Sampled segments
maxSegments.description: Maximum number of individual directly-follows segments sent to the canvas. Sampling preserves the fine-grained spectrum while keeping very large logs responsive.

maxBands.title: Visible segments
maxBands.description: Shows the most frequent activity-to-activity segments. The chart draws every sampled occurrence of the visible segments.

showHover.title: Hover details
showHover.description: Show the closest observed flow on hover. Disable this for the smoothest inspection on dense spectra.
